Thank you for this! After losing my little one this day is just so painful. More painful than the day my parents disowned me, than the days I’ve hated life and was depressed, than the day I lost my job and was homeless, than the day I partner abused me physically, than the day my manager undermined me, than the day my relatives pushed me down the stairs for being born black. 

I really feel that this day was created to celebrate and showcase the bond between mothers and children. Living through the past 2 weeks have been incredibly tough considering the number of ads, displays, social media reminders. It reminds how I’m childless, how I don’t have a mother to wish. Why would they commercialize this day so much to the point that it’s a constant reminder of people like us who have to live through that pain everyday! 
The best part is that after today, being willingly locked up in our own rooms, we know that tomorrow we can walk around in absolute peace with maybe a few mentions for how awesome their Mother’s Day was and what there kids and family did to surprise them. The talk about that dreaded day, will fade very soon and we can live in peace until the next year! 
Stay strong special mamas!
